benchmarks.label: Diazepam: acute cortical synaptic decay

observed.basis: Reported mean of within-cell percentage changes

benchmarks.preparation: Rat cortical pyramidal neurons, DIV 20–22; 7 days vehicle, then acute diazepam; mIPSCs at −70 mV with AMPA, NMDA and sodium-channel blockers.
limitations: Cortical miniature IPSC decay is compared with a rat hippocampal spontaneous IPSC peak-to-25% calibration reduced to a single exponential.
SEM describes this experiment, not model uncertainty or a human prediction interval.
Observed mean of within-cell changes differs from the ratio of the published group means; the reported 72.5% is used directly.
The comparison bypasses pharmacokinetics and substitutes bath concentration for modeled unbound brain concentration.

benchmarks.label: Diazepam: chronic tolerance is not modeled

observed.basis: Reported mean of within-cell percentage changes

benchmarks.preparation: Same cortical assay after 7 days of 1 µM diazepam, followed by an acute 1 µM challenge during recording.
limitations: The existing concentration-only decay mapping contains no exposure-history or tolerance state. Its acute output can be shown only as a counterfactual reference, not a simulated chronic regimen.
Adding a tolerance rate from a single endpoint would not identify adaptation or recovery kinetics.
This is a different cortical preparation and decay endpoint from the hippocampal calibration.

benchmarks.label: Diazepam: mouse amygdala synaptic decay

observed.basis: Derived ratio of reported group means: 100 × (24.3 / 16.3 − 1)

benchmarks.preparation: Mouse amygdala intercalated medial paracapsular neurons in acute slices; paired unitary IPSCs, 34 ±1 °C; diazepam bath application 12.5 ±1.5 minutes.
limitations: Species, region, receptor-subunit composition, preparation and IPSC endpoint differ from the rat hippocampal calibration.
The ratio of group means is not the mean of paired ratios. Its SEM cannot be recovered without paired covariance or individual recordings.
Only three recorded pairs contributed; this does not characterize a population-wide regional response.
No parameters are fitted to this benchmark.
